part1.title: Every Night At 9:14, Every Light Turns On… (Part 1/3) #shorts
part1.description:
Every night at exactly 9:14, every light in this dead city turns on. For one minute.
Tonight, only one window lit up… and someone was waving.

Who do you think is turning on the lights? Part 2 is up next.
#shorts #animation #mystery #survival #storytime
part1.comment: Who's turning on the lights? 👇 Drop your theory, then watch Part 2.

part2.title: Who's On The Stairs? (The 9:14 Lights, Part 2/3) #shorts
part2.description:
The stairwell light came on. So you went down… 23 floors.
In the lobby, a screen was waiting: "I am the city."

The machine, or the stranger? Who do you trust? Part 3 is the finale.
#shorts #animation #mystery #scifi #storytime
part2.comment: Machine or stranger? 🤖 vs 🪧 Comment who you trust.

part3.title: Lights Out (The 9:14 Lights, Part 3/3 - FINALE) #shorts
part3.description:
Four minutes until 9:14. One breaker. One chance to turn this city off forever.

Would you have pulled the lever? New story tomorrow.
#shorts #animation #survival #mystery #ending
part3.comment: Would you have pulled the lever? ⚡ Yes or no 👇
